# Red Point School

> > Red Point School offers 18+ comprehensive watercolor courses taught by world-class international artists, covering diverse subjects from urban landscapes and architecture to portraiture and abstract techniques.

Red Point School is an online platform dedicated to watercolor painting education, featuring courses in various styles and subjects including landscapes, architecture, portraiture, and experimental techniques. The school brings together 19 accomplished watercolor instructors from around the world to teach both beginner and intermediate artists.

## Key Topics

- Watercolor painting
- Online courses
- Landscape painting
- Urban landscapes
- Architecture painting
- Wet-on-wet technique
- Painting techniques
- Beginner-friendly
- Intermediate level
- Portrait painting
- Cityscapes
- Art instruction
- Floral painting
- Abstract techniques
- Seascape painting

## Getting Started

- [Online Watercolor Courses by World-Class Artists | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com): Red Point School homepage: 18+ watercolor courses from international artists.
- [Workshops for you](https://redpointschool.com/pages/workshops): Catalog of all available watercolor workshop marathons and courses.
- [Our Artists — World-Class Watercolor Instructors | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/teachers): Directory of 19 world-class watercolor instructors from international locations.

## Landscape & Nature Courses

- [Aerial Perspective Landscapes — Watercolor Course with Nicholas Tobias | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/aerialview): Landscape watercolor course: aerial perspective with Nicholas Tobias, 19 hours.
- [Poured Watercolor Landscapes — Course with Leslie Lambert | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/pouredwatercolor): Poured watercolor technique course: 6 landscapes with Leslie Lambert, 24 hours.
- [Energy of Water and Light — Watercolor Course with Olga Kozyra | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/energyofwater): Water and light watercolor course: 8 paintings with Olga Kozyra, 15 hours.
- [Nature's Glow — Watercolor Course with Marietta Smith | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/naturalglow): Landscape watercolor course: 8 glowing nature paintings with Marietta Smith, 18 hours.
- [Japanese Whispers of Nature — Watercolor Course with Wataru Ishigaki | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/japanesenature): Japanese watercolor course: 5 nature paintings with Wataru Ishigaki, 20.5 hours.
- [Coastal Stories — Watercolor Course with Reha Sakar | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/coastalstories): Seascape watercolor course: 8 coastal paintings with Reha Sakar, 19.5 hours.

## Urban & Architecture Courses

- [City Stories — Watercolor Course with Darya Mitta | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/citystories): Urban watercolor course: 10 city paintings with Darya Mitta, 14.5 hours.
- [Light & Shadow in Urban Landscape — Watercolor Course with Simon Schmidt | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/light-shadow-watercolor): Urban landscape course: master light and shadow with Simon Schmidt, 15 hours.
- [Urban Architecture — Watercolor Course with Adrian Marmolejo | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/urbanarchitecture): Architecture watercolor course: 8 cityscapes with Adrian Marmolejo, 6.5 hours.
- [World Architecture in Watercolor — Course with Achintya Hazra | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/worldarchitecture): Architecture watercolor course: 8 world landmarks with Achintya Hazra, 19 hours.
- [Atmospheric Buildings in Watercolor — Course with Nicholas Poullis | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/buildings-watercolor): Building watercolor course: 8 atmospheric paintings with Nicholas Poullis, 13 lessons.

## Specialized Techniques & Styles

- [Between Reality and Abstraction — Watercolor Course with Prasad Beaven | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/realabstract): Abstract watercolor course: 8 paintings between realism and abstraction, 8 hours.
- [India in Watercolor — Course with Vikrant Shitole | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/indiawatercolor): India watercolor course: 8 vibrant paintings with Vikrant Shitole, 19 hours.
- [Summer Garden — Watercolor Floral Course with Cecilia Xiao | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/summergarden): Floral watercolor course: 8 summer garden paintings with Cecilia Xiao, 17 hours.
- [Light and Femininity — Watercolor Portrait Course with Julia Ustinovich | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/lightandfem): Portrait watercolor course: 8 paintings with Julia Ustinovich, 14 hours.
- [Moments of Summer — Watercolor Course with Peto Poghosyan | Red Point School](https://redpointschool.com/pages/momentsofsummer): Summer watercolor course: 8 luminous paintings with Peto Poghosyan, 15 hours.
